links.outcome: Hallucinations and inappropriate responses from LLM answering only from uploaded case descriptions
links.effect: 99.3% (543/547) of responses appropriate; no hallucinations observed; the 4 inappropriate responses declined to provide information not in the case description.
links.quote: The proportion of questions that were answered appropriately was 99.3% (543/547).

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility and accuracy/hallucination rate of a custom LLM platform for trainee education in simulated case-based learning, but does not compare or test a specific deployment practice/guardrail.
